data.one_liner: Register system-wide and in-app keyboard shortcuts on desktop and Android
data.what_it_does: hotkey_manager lets you register global shortcuts that work even when your app is not focused, and in-app shortcuts that work with Flutter’s HardwareKeyboard. It uses nativeapi via Dart FFI for efficient, asynchronous registration across Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
use_when: You need a shortcut that works when the app is backgrounded
You want to handle media keys or custom key combinations on desktop
You need cross-platform support without writing platform-specific code
avoid_when: You only need simple in-app shortcuts that can be handled by Flutter’s Shortcuts/Actions
Your project targets older Flutter/Dart versions (pre 3.50/Dart 3.14)
strengths: Nativeapi integration gives fast, reliable global shortcuts
Supports both global and in-app scopes with async registration
Handles media keys and modifier-only shortcuts on all supported platforms
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.50+ and Dart 3.14, plus nativeapi 0.6.0
Adds a native dependency that may increase build size
Global shortcuts may conflict with system or other apps
data.setup_notes: Add hotkey_manager and nativeapi 0.6.0+ to pubspec. No build_runner needed. No special permissions required beyond what nativeapi needs.
